STORY: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
A gate attempt is one subtree, delegated once per attempt
A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
The runner carries its own event model, as its room gave it
The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
The run is one ORC tree, cycle.v1, and each effect the runner performs is a leaf of its own
A run grades only with the approved sealed grader
A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
A filed score has an Allure result for every checklist item
Measurement keeps its history across runs on the one store, so a scoreboard compares a cycle with the last measured cycle of its selection
A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
A run stopped with its runner resumes where it stopped
The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
